GRANDMASTER — EDEN/AppDev Canonical Backup — v1.1

Owner: Lucas Buzek

Purpose: consolidated, portable TXT backup of the current EDEN/AppDev
Grand profiles, Apps, Helpers, NamingRules and LINGUA localization
decisions. This package updates the registry-facing definitions without
inventing unresolved identities.

EDEN / APPDEV CANONICAL FOUNDATION

Owner: Lucas Buzek Snapshot date: 2026-09-22 Package version: v1.1

EDEN = Engineering, Development, Exploration & Nature.

Core principle: Beauty, capability and dignity should not be premium
features.

Core implementation rule: IMPLEMENT / INTEGRATE EXISTING CAPABILITY
BEFORE RECREATING IT.

Architecture: BIFROST = CONNECT & KEEP. HEIMDALL = ORGANIZE &
UNDERSTAND. SPECIALIST APPS = SPECIALIZE & DO. CONDUCTOR = shared
orchestration. AOS = substantial pipeline execution and continuation.
LCAS = truthful observation, control and status.

Quality: Generated ≠ Saved ≠ Verified ≠ Consolidated ≠ Released. Static
checks ≠ compile. Compile ≠ physical verification. Tests: PASS / FAIL /
UNKNOWN / SKIPPED / N/A. UNKNOWN is never PASS.

Data: LOCAL FIRST. USER DATA OUTLIVES SOFTWARE. INTEGRATIONS ARE
ADAPTERS, NOT OWNERS. MIGRATE, DO NOT RESET. RECOVERY IS A PRODUCT
FEATURE.

DIRECTORY

00_MASTER — consolidated master and changelog 01_GRAND_PACKS — Personal,
Family, Friends, Public/release profiles 02_APPS — current App/Product
identity cards 03_HELPERS — current shared Helper/Framework identity
cards 04_RULES — updated NamingRules and release/install rules 05_LINGUA
— language architecture and literary coverage-pack system 06_BACKUP —
provenance, unresolved queue and backup index 07_REGISTRY —
machine-readable JSON registry snapshot

IMPORTANT

This is a canonical documentation/registry backup. It does not claim
that every historical software package has been rebuilt or physically
tested. Existing source-code packages remain authoritative for their
actual code until separately rebuilt and verified.
